{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]] | [[Cookbook:Oyster|Oyster]]

==Ingredients==
*50 live small [[Cookbook:Oyster|oyster]]s
*¼ stick (4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] / 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Madeira|madeira]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] and [[Cookbook:Cayenne pepper|cayenne pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Rinse the oysters in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]] and drain well.
#[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the oysters in their shells in a large pot over medium high heat until they are done and dry, but not scorched.
#Remove the oysters from the shell onto a plate, without any of their liquor. Discard any oysters that failed to open.
#Add the butter. When the butter has melted, add to another pan and place on low heat. 
#Add the Madeira, a little salt and cayenne. Serve when the Madeira is heated.
